name: Blackberry Kush - Indica Live Resin 1g PLUS Vape Device
description: Immerse yourself in the rich, velvety depths of Blackberry Kush with its signature sweet berry flavors and robust earthy kush undertones. Featuring myrcene, limonene, and beta caryophyllene terpenes, this indica-dominant masterpiece delivers deeply relaxing and sedating effects perfect for evening unwind and restful sleep.
